author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Good news: your phone isn’t secretly listening to you.
Bad news: that would somehow be less disturbing.

Turns out it’s not your phone — it’s an entire industry scraping every legal gray-area breadcrumb you leave behind, packaging it up, and selling it to the highest bidder.
And yes… it somehow gets worse.

Watch the full video if you enjoy learning things that make you stare at your phone differently. https://youtu.be/M_6IRTSYHgc
